ATSAVI.name: ATSAVI
ATSAVI.formula: sla * (N - sla * R - slb) / (sla * N + R - sla * slb + 0.08 * (1 + sla ** 2.0))

AWEIsh.name: AWEIsh
AWEIsh.long_name: Automated Water Extraction Index with Shadows Elimination

BAIM.name: BAIM
BAIM.long_name: Burned Area Index adapted to MODIS

BWDRVI.name: BWDRVI
BWDRVI.long_name: Blue Wide Dynamic Range Vegetation Index

CI1woSWIR.name: CI1woSWIR
CI1woSWIR.long_name: Cloud Index Form 1 without SWIR bands

CI2SWIR.name: CI2SWIR
CI2SWIR.long_name: Cloud Index Form 2 with SWIR bands

CI2woSWIR.name: CI2woSWIR
CI2woSWIR.long_name: Cloud Index Form 2 without SWIR bands

CSIwoSWIR.name: CSIwoSWIR
CSIwoSWIR.long_name: Cloud Shadow Index without SWIR bands

GOSAVI.name: GOSAVI
GOSAVI.long_name: Green Optimized Soil Adjusted Vegetation Index

GRARI.name: GRARI
GRARI.formula: (N - (eta * G + (1.0 - eta) * R - lmb * (B - R)))/(N + (eta * G + (1.0 - eta) * R - lmb * (B - R)))

MCARI.name: MCARI
MCARI.long_name: Modified Chlorophyll Absorption in Reflectance Index

MCARI1.name: MCARI1
MCARI1.long_name: Modified Chlorophyll Absorption in Reflectance Index 1

MCARI2.name: MCARI2
MCARI2.long_name: Modified Chlorophyll Absorption in Reflectance Index 2

MCARI705.name: MCARI705
MCARI705.long_name: Modified Chlorophyll Absorption in Reflectance Index (705 and 750 nm)

MLSWI26.name: MLSWI26
MLSWI26.long_name: Modified Land Surface Water Index (MODIS Bands 2 and 6)

MLSWI27.name: MLSWI27
MLSWI27.long_name: Modified Land Surface Water Index (MODIS Bands 2 and 7)

NBSIMS.name: NBSIMS
NBSIMS.long_name: Non-Binary Snow Index for Multi-Component Surfaces

NDPI.name: NDPI
NDPI.formula: (N - (alpha * R + (1.0 - alpha) * S1))/(N + (alpha * R + (1.0 - alpha) * S1))

NDSIITM.name: NDSIITM
NDSIITM.long_name: Normalized Difference Snow/Ice Index for Landsat TM

NDSInw.name: NDSInw
NDSInw.long_name: Normalized Difference Snow Index with no Water

NDSaII.name: NDSaII
NDSaII.long_name: Normalized Difference Snow and Ice Index

NDTI4RE.name: NDTI4RE
NDTI4RE.long_name: 4-band Red Edge Normalized Difference Tillage Index
NDTI4RE.formula: gamma * (S1 - S2)/(S1 + S2) + (1 - gamma) * (N - RE3)/(N + RE3)

NDVI4RE.name: NDVI4RE
NDVI4RE.long_name: 4-band Red Edge Normalized Difference Vegetation Index
NDVI4RE.formula: ((alpha * RE3 + (1 - alpha) * RE2) - (beta * R + (1 - beta) * RE1))/((alpha * RE3 + (1 - alpha) * RE2) + (beta * R + (1 - beta) * RE1))

NDVI705.name: NDVI705
NDVI705.long_name: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (705 and 750 nm)

NDWIns.name: NDWIns
NDWIns.long_name: Normalized Difference Water Index with no Snow Cover and Glaciers

NSDSI1.name: NSDSI1
NSDSI1.long_name: Normalized Shortwave-Infrared Difference Bare Soil Moisture Index 1

NSDSI2.name: NSDSI2
NSDSI2.long_name: Normalized Shortwave-Infrared Difference Bare Soil Moisture Index 2

NSDSI3.name: NSDSI3
NSDSI3.long_name: Normalized Shortwave-Infrared Difference Bare Soil Moisture Index 3

RENDVI.name: RENDVI
RENDVI.long_name: Red Edge Normalized Difference Vegetation Index

RVI4RE.name: RVI4RE
RVI4RE.formula: (alpha * RE3 + (1 - alpha) * RE2)/(beta * R + (1 - beta) * RE1)

SARVI.name: SARVI
SARVI.long_name: Soil Adjusted and Atmospherically Resistant Vegetation Index
SARVI.formula: (1 + L)*(N - (R - gamma * (R - B))) / (N + (R - gamma * (R - B)) + L)

SAVI4RE.name: SAVI4RE
SAVI4RE.long_name: 4-band Red Edge Soil Adjusted Vegetation Index
SAVI4RE.formula: 2.0 * ((alpha * RE3 + (1 - alpha) * RE2) - (beta * R + (1 - beta) * RE1))/((alpha * RE3 + (1 - alpha) * RE2) + (beta * R + (1 - beta) * RE1 + 1))

SNDTI4RE.name: SNDTI4RE
SNDTI4RE.long_name: 4-band Red Edge Soil-Adjusted Normalized Difference Tillage Index

TCARI.name: TCARI
TCARI.long_name: Transformed Chlorophyll Absorption in Reflectance Index

TSAVI.name: TSAVI
TSAVI.formula: sla * (N - sla * R - slb) / (sla * N + R - sla * slb)

WCI1.name: WCI1
WCI1.formula: -1.0 * ((B - R + RE1)/(B + R + RE1 + epsilon)) * ((G + R)/(B + N + epsilon))

WCI2.name: WCI2
WCI2.formula: -1.0 * ((B + G + RE1)/(R + epsilon)) * ((B + R + RE1)/(N + epsilon))

sNIRvLSWI.name: sNIRvLSWI
sNIRvLSWI.long_name: SWIR-enhanced Near-Infrared Reflectance of Vegetation for LSWI

sNIRvNDPI.name: sNIRvNDPI
sNIRvNDPI.long_name: SWIR-enhanced Near-Infrared Reflectance of Vegetation for NDPI
sNIRvNDPI.formula: (N - (alpha * R + (1.0 - alpha) * S2))/(N + (alpha * R + (1.0 - alpha) * S2)) * N

sNIRvNDVILSWIP.name: sNIRvNDVILSWIP
sNIRvNDVILSWIP.long_name: SWIR-enhanced Near-Infrared Reflectance of Vegetation for the NDVI-LSWI Product

sNIRvNDVILSWIS.name: sNIRvNDVILSWIS
sNIRvNDVILSWIS.long_name: SWIR-enhanced Near-Infrared Reflectance of Vegetation for the NDVI-LSWI Sum
